scholarship_name: Government of Brunei Darussalam Scholarship for Foreign Students Tenable in Brunei Darussalam - 2026/2027
provider_name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Brunei Darussalam
ielts_requirement_text: English proficiency may be demonstrated by IELTS 6.0, GCE O Level Credit 6, IGCSE English Grade C, or another accepted route stated by the official scholarship.
toefl_requirement_text: TOEFL minimum 550 is one accepted English-proficiency route; alternative English qualifications are also accepted.
tuition_coverage: Full exemption from tuition fees including acceptance, examination, registration and orientation fees for the duration of the programme
travel_allowance: Economy-class airfare to Brunei before commencement and return airfare after completion; baggage allowance also provided according to destination region
accommodation_support: Accommodation at the residential college of the university or polytechnic
health_insurance: Comprehensive insurance cover for the whole duration of the scholarship
required_documents: Certified academic qualifications and supporting documents
Certified English translations for documents not in English

scholarship_name: Universiti Brunei Darussalam Graduate Research Scholarship (UGRS)
ielts_requirement_text: UBD graduate English proficiency may be demonstrated by IELTS Academic 6.0, accepted school English qualifications, TOEFL PBT 550, UBD-EPT B2, or another applicable programme-specific route.
toefl_requirement_text: UBD graduate English proficiency may be demonstrated by TOEFL PBT 550, IELTS Academic 6.0, UBD-EPT B2, or another accepted qualification; programme-specific requirements may be higher.
tuition_coverage: Tuition fees including registration and acceptance fees waived for 36 months
travel_allowance: One incoming and one outgoing economy-class air ticket for candidates not residing in Brunei; overseas research or conference funding up to BND 3,000
accommodation_support: Free on-campus accommodation for 36 months, excluding applicable administrative fees
required_documents: Academic qualifications required by UBD graduate admission
Passport or identification documents required by UBD admission
application_cycle: Recurring UBD Graduate Research Scholarship; current scheme verified 2026-08-23
